Name: IBL Widefield
Description: This dataset contains widefield imaging data from mice, investigating how prior expectations and neural dynamics are modified in a mouse model of autism (CNTNALP2 knockout). The study explores sensory perception and decision-making tasks to understand the neural basis of altered prior utilization.
